title: Routes 12–18, Fuchsia City & Safari Zone
subtitle: Snorlax, Super Rod, Soul Badge, Surf, Strength, Fly, Cycling Road

steps.text: Route 12 (south of Lavender): play the Poké Flute next to Snorlax (Lv.30). One-time encounter — save first, use False Swipe/Sleep and Great Balls. Snorlax is a top-tier team member.

encounter.savePoint: Save standing next to Snorlax before using the Poké Flute
encounter.note: One-time. Catch rate 25: bring Ultra Balls, False Swipe or sleep.

steps.text: Lavender-side gate on Route 12, 2F: a girl gives TM27 Return if your lead Pokémon likes you enough.
Route 12 fishing house (on the pier): the Fishing Guru's brother gives the Super Rod. Show him big Magikarp for Net Balls.
Route 13: zig-zag fences full of trainers; Ditto, Venonat and Pidgeotto in the grass.
Route 14: more trainers, Bird Keepers with Flying types.
Route 15 to Fuchsia. Gate 2F: Oak's aide gives the Exp. Share once you have caught 50 species.
Fuchsia City, southeast-most house: the Fishing Guru's brother gives the Good Rod.
Substitute Move Tutor in Fuchsia (house near the Safari Zone entrance).

Safari Zone ($500, 500 steps, 30 Safari Balls): Chansey, Scyther, Kangaskhan, Tauros, Exeggcute, Rhyhorn, Nidoran evolutions; Dratini and Psyduck with rods. Throw Bait to keep them from fleeing, Rocks to catch easier.
Safari Zone Area 3 (far northwest, West area): the Secret House rewards you with HM03 Surf. Gold Teeth lie on the ground nearby.
Warden's House (southeast Fuchsia): give the Warden his Gold Teeth for HM04 Strength. The Rare Candy in the back room needs Strength.

Koga: Koffing Lv.37 ×2, Muk Lv.39, Weezing Lv.43 (Self-Destruct, Toxic). Psychic and Ground moves; Kadabra/Alakazam, Dugtrio, Nidoking's Earthquake. Bring Antidotes. The gym has invisible walls: walk along the edges.
Gym Leader Koga. Soul Badge (Surf usable) and TM06 Toxic.
Route 18 gate 2F (west of Fuchsia): trade a Slowbro for Marc the Lickitung.
Route 17 Cycling Road (needs the Bicycle): Bikers and Cue Balls, five hidden items along the slope.
Route 16: the second Snorlax (Lv.30) blocks the road toward Celadon. Poké Flute, save, catch.

encounter.savePoint: Save next to Snorlax before the Poké Flute
encounter.note: Second and last Snorlax in the game.

steps.text: Route 16 northwest house (Cut the tree): the girl gives HM02 Fly. Teach it to Pidgeot/Fearow/Charizard and stop walking.
Route 16 south gate 2F: Amulet Coin from Oak's aide (40 species caught).
